decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt extends an established, popular biodynamic range that fits the firm's core organic positioning, so it is a low-risk staple worth keeping.
Mild sliced cheese is a recent launch close to the firm's in-house cheesemaking and is presented on its own page, so it deserves more time to build retail listings.
Sliced butter cheese is a mainstream organic retail format that uses existing cheesemaking capacity, and a 2024 launch is unlikely to be cut this quickly.
